analysis.execution: Static inspection only. Archives decompressed; Ruby/VBS members inspected with cleave facts. No sample code, build hooks, package installers or remote payloads were executed.
analysis.decoding: Fragmented Base64/zlib payloads and 106 BrowserStack wrappers decoded as data using Python.

rule_changes: Bind socket duplication, popen input/output and downloaded file execution to their actual values.
Add install-time hidden loader and host-profile callback detection.
Detect actual private-key/cloud-credential helper collection with JSON POST sender, including intermediate body variables.
Cover old Metasploit3 class declarations without condemning a print-only module.
Recognize ransom rename/encryption/Task Manager impact and VBS wallet replacement, Run persistence and source deletion.
Remove unsupported NETCONF malicious inference, unsent-POST exfiltration, PAN-OS-specific names and shadow-read claim derived only from path references.
Put decoding, hexadecimal packing, HTTP retrieval references and NETCONF capabilities in neutral homes; consolidate a duplicate Ruby Base64 selector.
Recognize declared security regression seeds and expected-verdict tables; preserve payload/capability findings outside those exact test contexts.
Correct Docker host fixture URLs and ordinary local cron registration; require an actual setuid call instead of a quoted demo title.
Restore precise actual SSH-key POST and secret-filtered environment JSON POST flows, and relabel stale duplicate fixtures to their reviewed endpoint meaning.
Retire the old generic NETCONF command-element literal combination; retain neutral SSH-backed NETCONF client observation and source/import facts.
